title: Replace trader's plates
summary: This page provides instructions on how to apply for replacement trader's plates at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
Trader's plates are, and always remain, the property of Transport for NSW. If they're lost or stolen, you must report it to the police within 7 days of the incident.

To apply for replacement trader's plate(s), please visit a Service NSW Centre.
what_you_need: a list of all the trader's plates you currently hold
the last 3 months' Record of Use sheets for all trader's plates currently held
Police Event Number for lost or stolen plates, or the damaged plates if the plates are damaged
vehicle details that will be associated with the replacement plates
either: (The content lists 'either:' but does not specify the options, so this is kept as is.)

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Trader's Plate Application – PDF (if applicable).
Make sure you have all the required documentation and the damaged plate(s) (if applicable).
Visit a service centre and submit your application.
